# security-openbao

<!-- BEGIN DECLARED (generated by scripts/wiki-compile.py — do not edit) -->

> Source comment, verbatim from `kustomization.yaml`:
>
> OpenBao — secret store (MPL-2.0, Linux Foundation). API-compatible with Vault.
>
> Single node, raft integrated storage, TLS terminated at Traefik. Replaces
> security/vault (BUSL-1.1, file storage, no unseal story).
>
> Resources: StatefulSet (openbao), Services (openbao, openbao-internal),
> ServiceAccount + ClusterRoleBinding (system:auth-delegator for
> kubernetes auth), ConfigMap (openbao-config, with an audit device
> to stdout), NetworkPolicy, Ingress
>
> Unseal modes
> - Shamir (default): a human runs `bao operator init` once and
> `bao operator unseal` after every restart.
> kubectl -n security exec openbao-0 -- bao operator init
> kubectl -n security exec -it openbao-0 -- bao operator unseal
> - Static key: optional sub-component seal-static/.
>
> After init, configure it once with scripts/openbao/bootstrap.sh (kv-v2, kubernetes
> auth for External Secrets, SSH CA for agents, policies/). Idempotent.
>
> Who may reach port 8200 (NetworkPolicy)
> - pods in the same namespace
> - the traefik namespace (Ingress)
> - any namespace labelled  ait.aitizate.com/openbao-access=true
> kubectl label ns external-secrets ait.aitizate.com/openbao-access=true
>
> Storage: raft needs block or local storage. Do NOT put the PVC on NFS.
> The PVC has no storageClassName: the tenant picks one (patch the volumeClaimTemplate).
>
> Namespace: `security` by default. A tenant overlay's `namespace:` moves the component
> and its sub-components; api_addr / cluster_addr follow on their own (BAO_API_ADDR and
> BAO_CLUSTER_ADDR are built from the pod's namespace). Add the follow-namespace/
> transformer to the same overlay so the ClusterRoleBinding subject and the eso-store
> server follow too:
> namespace: my-namespace
> transformers:
> - path/to/security/openbao/follow-namespace
>
> Tenant overlay can patch:
> - Ingress hostname (placeholder: openbao.example.com)
> - Storage class and size of the data PVC
> - Resources (defaults fit an edge node: 50m/64Mi requests)
> - Replicas (HA needs retry_join in the config, see docs/apps/openbao.md)
>
> Pod Security: runs under the `restricted` profile.

## Notes

What it is for: the store where secrets live, issuing short-lived credentials to
people and AI agents, plus an SSH CA. Replaces
[security-vault](security-vault.md) (BUSL-1.1). The recommended pairing is
[security-external-secrets](security-external-secrets.md) syncing from it through
[eso-store](security-openbao-eso-store.md); see
[secret strategy](../concepts/secret-strategy.md).

- **Configuration is a script, not a manifest**: `scripts/openbao/bootstrap.sh`
  (kv-v2, auth methods, SSH CA, policies under `policies/`, admins), run once
  after `bao operator init`. Guide: [`docs/apps/openbao.md`](../../docs/apps/openbao.md).
- **Sub-directories**: `seal-static`, `raft-snapshot` and `eso-store` are
  Components (an overlay lists them under `components:`); `follow-namespace` is a
  transformer (`transformers:`). The `openbao-secrets` use case composes all four.
- **Namespace**: `security` by default. An overlay's `namespace:` plus
  [follow-namespace](security-openbao-follow-namespace.md) in the same
  kustomization moves everything; `api_addr` / `cluster_addr` are built by the
  pod from its own namespace.
- **NetworkPolicy**: clients outside the namespace need
  `ait.aitizate.com/openbao-access=true` on theirs, or the connection is refused.
- **Proof**: [usecases-openbao-secrets](../overlays/usecases-openbao-secrets.md)
  runs the whole lifecycle in CI (`validate-usecases.yml`).
